name: english-only-artifact-guards
title: Enforce English-only artifacts via a warn-only PreToolUse hook plus a diff/story-scoped CJK gate in lattice validate
description: The English-only-artifacts rule currently lives only as a memory/prompt-layer fact with no mechanical enforcement. During B-4fd3 the agent had that memory loaded yet still wrote Lattice story metadata and commit messages in Chinese, because a passively-recalled context line does not fire at the action point. Per the CLAUDE.md flow-fact double-layer contract, a process/quality fact needs prompt guidance PLUS a hardcoded gate fallback. Add two layers: (1) a warn-only PreToolUse hook that detects CJK characters in git commit / lattice story-metadata commands and prints an immediate warning (non-blocking); (2) a diff/story-scoped CJK check in lattice validate that hard-blocks REVIEW to TEST when the current story commit messages or author-controlled story metadata contain CJK. Both must be forward-looking and scoped to the current story / branch diff only, never the whole repo (legacy Chinese must not be retroactively flagged). Out of scope: retroactively translating existing files, and scanning arbitrary code/doc files (coverage = commits + lattice story metadata).
